records.text: Owens said multiple sources with direct knowledge reported that Val Peterson was allegedly golfing in Heber, Utah; one person claimed he was taking part in a tournament, but she did not identify a particular club or tournament.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Well, thanks to you sleuths back at home and some brave yet clearly terrified faculty members at UVU, we were able to put some more pieces together. We confirmed from multiple sources with direct knowledge that he was golfing, actually, allegedly, out in Heber, Utah. ... and one person claimed that he was actually taking part in a tournament. We found a few clubs and tournaments that could potentially match that description, but we don't need to venture a specific guess as to which one he was at, suffice it to say.
